title: A2v10 <name>.operation.json (operation of a document)
description: One operation of a document: document/<x>/<name>.operation.json, listed in 'operations' of document/<x>/metadata.json. An operation is what the user switches inside an open document, so it holds only what is re-evaluated on a switch - 'post' and 'rules'. Birth and address (initialValues, autonum, fixed, forms, traits) belong to the document.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it - no generator, runtime or deploy.

post.description: What posting a document of this operation does - the same entries as 'post' of a document. Exactly one 'post' is in force at the moment of posting: the one of the operation the document carries.

rules.description: Rules of the header that hold while the document carries this operation: the platform turns them into 'when' under the operation's code, layered over the document's. 'inherit' and 'total' are refused at load - not generated under a condition.

details.description: Collection key -> rules of that collection, and of its kinds, under this operation. The shape is the document's; nothing else is declared here.
